notes.title: Jet Car Stunts Live-Stream (Twitch) + Steam Key GIVE AWAY
notes.content:
Would you like to see how Jet Car Stunts is meant to be played?

Then look us up on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/bitcomposer]Twitch[/url] at 17:00 CEST / 16:00 BST / 09:00 MDT. The producer of Jet Car Stunts, Michael, will show you how to rule the Jet Cars "LIVE"!

But that is not enough!
Our Community Manager, Andreas, will moderate the chat and toss out a few goodies every now and then. So look out for clues and you may get some Steam keys during the stream (not only JCS of course)! 

Ask any question you like. We may even answer some of them! 

Follow us on [i][url=https://twitter.com/bit_Composer]Twitter[/url][/i] and [i][url=https://www.facebook.com/bitComposer.Games]Facebook[/url][/i]! 

See you on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/bitcomposer]Twitch[/url] later this evening!

Oh. And yes. Some minor bugs have been fixed lately. Some people had problems with the speed of the game and some controller issues. These should now be gone.

notes.title: Jet Car Stunts released + ION ASSAULT FOR FREE!
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that [b]Jet Car Stunts[/b] is finally on Steam! 

Buy Jet Car Stunts until the [b]8th of May[/b] and get additional [b]ION ASSAULT [/b] for free!

Thanks everyone for support and enjoy the game!
